title: Antimicrobial Stewardship Review Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Review antimicrobial choice, dose, route, and duration against culture data and likely source within 48 to 72 hours.
De-escalate or stop therapy promptly when microbiology, source control, or clinical trajectory supports narrowing.
Check renal function and allergy history before continuing nephrotoxic or high-risk antimicrobial regimens.

title: High-Risk Anticoagulation Safety Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Review renal function, indication, and interacting drugs before initiating or continuing therapeutic anticoagulation.
Escalate immediately when active bleeding, severe anemia, or urgent procedure planning changes anticoagulation risk.
Document indication, monitoring plan, and reversal strategy clearly for high-risk patients.

contraindications.label: active_bleeding
contraindications.reason: Active major bleeding is a major safety concern requiring urgent review before ongoing anticoagulation.

title: Medication Reconciliation Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Compare prior, inpatient, and discharge medication lists at every transition of care.
Resolve duplicate therapies, omissions, and route/dose discrepancies before finalizing orders or discharge instructions.
Prioritize high-alert medicines, insulin, anticoagulants, and renal-dose medications during reconciliation.
